Materials

Material Definition

Material definitions for battery thermal models.

class liiontr.materials.material.Material[source]

Bases: object

Represent a homogeneous material.

Parameters:

  • name (str) – Human-readable material name.

  • density (ConstantProperty) – Mass density in kg/m³.

  • heat_capacity (ConstantProperty) – Specific heat capacity in J/(kg·K).

  • thermal_conductivity (ConstantProperty) – Thermal conductivity in W/(m·K).

Notes

The current implementation uses temperature-independent material properties through ConstantProperty.

__init__(name, density, heat_capacity, thermal_conductivity)
Parameters:

  • name (str)

  • density (ConstantProperty)

  • heat_capacity (ConstantProperty)

  • thermal_conductivity (ConstantProperty)

Return type:

None

Material Properties

Thermophysical property models for LiionTR materials.

class liiontr.materials.properties.ConstantProperty[source]

Bases: object

Represent a temperature-independent material property.

Parameters:

  • value (float) – Numerical value of the property.

  • unit (str) – Physical unit associated with the property.

Return the constant property value.
